count_semantics: Counts are family assignments only. They are not counts of eligible Lean theorem tasks, completed outcomes, independent components, or proof-transfer trials.

validation_families_excluded_from_baseli.reason: Inspected as a development-only prime/density near-neighbour negative control; see exposure-audit.md E-003.

test_families_excluded_from_confirmatory.reason: Inspected before its split assignment was checked; see exposure-audit.md E-001.

limitations: The original frozen split is preserved. Exclusions live in this derived manifest and the exposure audit; do not edit or reshuffle splits.json.
Family counts do not imply that every remaining family has an eligible theorem task. Preserve raw, eligible, excluded, unknown, missing-artifact, and not-attempted task counts separately.
Known researcher-side exposure is not proof of model pretraining contamination, and a clean exposure log cannot prove the absence of pretraining contamination.
Training-family use for source annotations and curated development controls is intentional and does not reduce the training assignment count.
